rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: To lay hold of and carry off
content.ART_PROMPT: A garden path at dawn between dark cedars, a single leather sandal left on the stones and a column of radiant golden light lifting upward through the branches, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, deep shadowed background, one radiant golden light source, rich saturated blues and golds
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Add one card from the top of the Tower to your hand. Then look at one card from the top of the Tower; you may put that card on the bottom of the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: Take, eat; this is my body
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 2:15 — “the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Matthew 26:26 — “Take, eat; this is my body”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Genesis 5:24 ends with three words: God took him. Enoch is the one man of the era who does not die.
The woman took of the fruit and did eat; the same verb carries both the taking in Eden and the taking of bread at the last supper.
Lambano means both to take and to receive; John 1:12 says as many as received him.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Every filled pip is one flat, solid, uniformly dark navy disc with no highlight, gloss, gradient, inner ring, or concentric texture; every empty pip is a thin navy outline with plain parchment interior. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
